Edge-AI microcontrollers + "TinyEngine" NPU for on-device AI (sensors, predictive maintenance, autonomy)

TI Virtual Recruiter Chatbot on the careers site: an AI-powered conversational assistant that lets candidates ask questions in their preferred language and get matched to job opportunities. TI publishes a formal 'Important AI Notice' governing candidate use of the tool, and it is live in production on careers.ti.com.

AI-driven predictive maintenance and robotic material handling in TI's new 300mm wafer fabs (part of the $60B U.S. fab expansion / SM1 mega-site) to maximize yield, reduce waste, and cut downtime in its Smart Manufacturing & Automation strategy.

Internal AI-assisted software development for TI's Smart Manufacturing & Automation team: engineers use Claude Code (Anthropic), GitHub Copilot, and Cursor plus emerging agentic frameworks to accelerate building the software that runs manufacturing/test operations. TI is explicitly hiring engineers experienced with these tools to scale development across the organization. [Anthropic Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor]

Computer-vision models for semiconductor manufacturing quality and test — image classification, defect detection, and anomaly detection on inline and end-of-line data — developed and deployed at scale by TI's Smart Manufacturing & Automation team, including model monitoring and retraining pipelines.

LLM-based systems for manufacturing — RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) pipelines, prompt engineering, and agentic workflows built on OpenAI/Anthropic APIs and LangChain-style frameworks — to address challenges faced by TI's manufacturing and engineering teams (e.g., correlating manufacturing data). [OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain]

Data-science machine-learning models and analytical solutions that accelerate semiconductor manufacturing — developed and deployed by a dedicated Senior Data Scientist function to solve manufacturing/engineering problems (yield and test/quality correlation across inline and end-of-line data).
